sloka: विस्फारयितुमारेभे ततः स धनुरुत्तमम्।महावेगं महानादं निर्भिन्दन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.१००.१५ ।।
transliteration: visphārayitumārebhe tataḥ sa dhanuruttamam।mahāvegaṁ mahānādaṁ nirbhindanniva medinīm ।। 6.100.15 ।।

translations.english: Then he began to stretch his best bow endowed with an impelling force, sounding as if breaking the earth.
